item.title: Dai wa Shou o Kanenai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Eleonora
  • 発売日: 2012-08-10
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 大は小を兼ねない
  • 英語名: Dai wa Shou o Kanenai

别名

  • Largeness doesn‛＼t hold the smallness concurrently

あらすじ

The protagonist, Itsuki Tenkubashi, is a student council member responsible for accounting. He didn’t volunteer to become a member but couldn’t refuse when asked.

Because of this aspect of his personality, he often faces various difficulties. Even so, he leads a life that is far from dramatic, one that could be described as ordinary.

item.title: Pink Sisters ~Sabasaba Shiteiru no ni Jitsu wa Ubu na Onee-chan to, Onii-chan ga Daisuki na Imouto~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Eleonora
  • 発売日: 2011-06-10
  • スコア: 5.779999999999999/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ぴんく・シスターズ～さばさばしているのに実はうぶなお姉ちゃんと、お兄ちゃんが大好きな妹～
  • 英語名: Pink Sisters Sabasaba Shiteiru no ni Jitsu wa Ubu na Onee-chan to, Onii-chan ga Daisuki na Imouto

あらすじ

Kazuya, the protagonist, is the middle child of three siblings.

His parents, both scholars, are often away on archaeology excavations, leaving him to handle the household chores in place of his lazy older sister and clumsy younger sister.

His days are filled with taking care of the house, dealing with his teasing older sister, Narumi, and looking after his scatterbrained younger sister, Chie.
